verdict.rationale: Cactus's own docs mention 2-bit model exports on the paid platform. A community benchmark references a fine-tuned Needle 3 W4A8 build, which suggests 4-bit weight and 8-bit activation quantization exists. There is no first-party documentation of a selectable range of integer formats, of 8-bit weight quantization, or of memory-footprint savings. missing for 10: documented list of supported bit-widths from low-bit through 8-bit, first-party docs on how to choose or apply quantization levels, memory-footprint figures, independent corroboration of the 2-bit exports.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision

citations.quote: use the platform for hosted GPUs, full-model training, a trained confidence head and 2-bit exports
